subject: MedAlign: billing cadence, PO references, and volume discount ask
messages:
From: MedAlign Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medalign.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@medalign.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing cadence & PO requirements for Redwood engagement

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — happy to move forward but procurement has a few constraints we need to confirm before issuing a master PO. High level asks below:

1) PO structure: our AP needs a single master PO with the ability to reference multiple sub-PO lines (we label these as PO:MDAL-<sub>-YYYY). Can you accept sub-PO references on each invoice line?

2) Invoice cadence: we consolidate vendor invoices into a monthly statement but require weekly remittance files (CSV) for our ERPs. We need Redwood to (a) aggregate invoices into a monthly statement, and (b) provide a weekly remittance export that maps invoice -> sub-PO -> ledger code.

3) Net terms: standard for us is Net 75. If you cannot accept Net 75, please propose alternatives (e.g., Net 45 + early-pay discount).

4) Discount/packaging: MedAlign is evaluating committed usage tiers (12-month ramp). We are requesting a volume discount schedule tied to committed vCPU/token thresholds and a one-time onboarding credit. Please let us know tiers and effective discounting.

5) Tax & vendor setup: we require DUNS and W-9 (US vendor). I'll attach our PO template.

We need this answered by Friday (1/16) to keep our board procurement cycle.

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Head of Procurement | MedAlign Inc
procurement@medalign.com

Attachments: MedAlign_PO_Template.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: MedAlign Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence & PO requirements for Redwood engagement

Tom / Sara,

Appreciate the clarity — happy to work through this. Quick answers and next steps below; looping in Priyom (sales) and Vanessa (account ops) who will detail billing mechanics. Vivek (finance) will be asked to confirm acceptable terms.

Summary response:
- Sub-PO refs: yes — we can include a custom PO reference field on each invoice line.
- Invoice cadence: we can emit consolidated monthly statements and deliver weekly remittance CSVs; need to align column mapping to your ERP (can you share sample remittance layout?).
- Net terms: we'll propose a compromise below after Priyom and finance weigh in.
- Discount tiers & onboarding credit: Priyom will propose a tier schedule and the onboarding credit amount based on the 12-month commitment.
- Tax & vendor setup: please send the DUNS and any tax forms; we will return a Redwood_W-9.pdf and vendor setup info.

Next steps: Priyom will send a formal commercial proposal with tiered pricing and a payment-term option set (Net 75 acceptance vs Net 45 + early-pay). Vanessa will coordinate invoice/remittance format mapping. Can we schedule a 30-min call Monday 1/12 to lock the remittance CSV layout?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medalign.com>, MedAlign Procurement <procurement@medalign.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing & packaging proposal (MedAlign) — initial draft

Tom / team,

Thanks — below is an initial commercial proposal to address your asks. This is a draft for procurement and finance review; we can update after the Monday call on remittance mapping.

Proposal highlights:
- Commitment: 12-month committed spend band with quarterly true-up. Commitment bands: Bronze ($150k/year), Silver ($400k/year), Gold ($1.2M/year). Discounts applied as 5% / 12% / 22% off list respectively.
- Onboarding credit: $25k applied against first invoice for Gold, $7.5k for Silver, $2k for Bronze.
- Billing & PO handling: Redwood to accept a Master PO with sub-PO references on each invoice line. We will include PO:MDAL-<sub> in the invoice metadata and export that to the remittance CSV.
- Invoice cadence options: (A) Net 75: accept as-is, no early-pay discount. (B) Net 45 + 1.5% early-pay if paid within 15 days; Redwood Finance will accept Net 45 under Silver+ commitments.
- For Gold: we can accept Net 75 with one additional concession — we will issue monthly statements and weekly remittance CSVs, and provide a dedicated account engineer for onboarding.

Requirements from MedAlign: sample remittance CSV layout, DUNS number, and a signed PO using your template. I attached Redwood_W-9.pdf for vendor setup.

I'll leave open action items below.

Action items:
1) MedAlign: send remittance CSV sample and DUNS (Tom/Sara)
2) Redwood (Vanessa): confirm remittance export columns and cadence on Monday call
3) Redwood (Vivek): finance to confirm Net75 acceptance for Gold tier and formalize early-pay language

Attaching: Redwood_W-9.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medalign.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing & packaging proposal (MedAlign) — finance confirmation

Tom / team,

Following up from Priyom's draft — finance has reviewed and here is the formal stance. We aim to be pragmatic while protecting cashflow.

1) Net terms: for Gold commitments (>= $1.2M/year) we will accept Net 75. For Silver ($400k/year) we can accept Net 75 on a pilot month but require a signed commitment schedule and a 2% prepay holdback that will be released after the first two billing cycles. For Bronze, we cannot accept Net 75; we can offer Net 45 with 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days.

2) Early-pay discount language: to be explicit in the SOW/Invoice: "1.5% discount applied to invoice if payment received within 15 days from invoice date." This will be included in amendment language.

3) Remittance files: Redwood will produce weekly remittance CSVs mapping invoice -> sub-PO -> ledger_code. Vanessa: please confirm header names.

4) Compliance: we'll need MedAlign's DUNS and a completed tax form (attached).

If MedAlign can sign the Gold-level commitment we will also include a one-time onboarding credit ($25k) and agree to Net 75 with no prepay holdback. Otherwise, the Net 45 + early-pay offer stands for lower tiers.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
